CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was provided.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (C), presentation as organized coordinate sets (O), and separate origin/status fields (D) are all present for the same identified referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal substrings identify specific content items and attributes (color) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields are listed separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing content identification from its source/status.

O.rationale: Content is presented as organized coordinate sets across nodes/candidates, indicating representation/presentation structure.
